title: Audiomack Creator-Upload Music
full_description: THE ULTIMATE APP FOR ARTISTS! Upload unlimited songs, albums, and podcasts for free and share them for FREE Share music in a FREE link and player, view stats, top fans and influencers, see where your music is trending globally, and more!Audiomack provides FREE upload and stats for artists, podcasters, radio hosts, and creators of all types. Our free upload feature allows you to share your songs, albums, and podcasts to Audiomack's millions of users, and everyone else in the world. You can share MP3s, WAV, M4A, AAC, and other local files right from the app.KEY FEATURES• Upload songs, albums, podcasts, and other audio content right from your phone to Audiomack.• View statistics on plays, favorites, playlist additions, re-ups.• Reply to comments from fans right from the app.• Share milestones and achievements as you rack up plays, favorites, playlist additions, re-ups, and other trophies.• See which countries and cities around the globe your uploads and music is getting plays in.• Explore what pages in the app your content is getting plays from.• Meet your top fans and most influential listeners.• Dive into our educational artist guides to learn how to take your career to the next level.• And much more!Use of the Audiomack App and free upload feature is subject to your agreement with our Privacy Policy/TOS.Privacy Policy: http://www.audiomack.com/privacy-policyTOS: http://www.audiomack.com/about/terms-of-service
